name: aegis-qa
description: Aegis QA - Advanced quality assurance orchestrator with hardware protection and AI-powered analysis

scripts.build:portable: npm run build:obfuscated && pkg dist-obfuscated/portable-entry.js --targets node18-win-x64,node18-linux-x64,node18-macos-x64 --output binaries/
scripts.build:exe: npm run build && pkg dist/portable-entry.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output binaries/aegis.exe
scripts.build:exe-protected: npm run build:obfuscated && pkg dist-obfuscated/portable-entry.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output binaries/aegis-protected.exe
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:obfuscated && pkg dist-obfuscated/portable-entry.js --targets node18-linux-x64 --output binaries/aegis-linux
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:obfuscated && pkg dist-obfuscated/portable-entry.js --targets node18-macos-x64 --output binaries/aegis-mac
